scope_limitations: This audit checks source currency, provenance and exact article text for five demo-critical articles only; it is not a full-corpus legal currency audit.
The official portal item URLs were not preserved in the original download artifacts; the manifest retains the portal URL, snapshot date and source hashes.

The SAMR rendered Criminal Law page is a consolidated text through Amendment 11. Amendment 12 scope and the 2026 current-law directory were therefore checked separately before treating the four unaffected Criminal Law articles as current.
A web search can fail to surface newly enacted changes. Recheck the official database immediately before submission, every classroom term and before any real legal use.

Article-text currency does not prove that a model's application of Article 20 or Article 177 to case facts is legally correct. The case3 non-prosecution branch remains a model/demo result pending independent legal-expert review.
